text: It is always a pleasure to visit Blue Tree. After enjoying a nice breakfast at one of the many spots inside this complex, my wife and I love to walk around and take in the surroundings. It is the perfect setting for a relaxed and pleasant conversation, surrounded by beautiful greenery and fascinating architecture. The place is incredibly well equipped: it features a wide variety of gyms, restaurants, a hair salon, massage shops, a kids' club, and even an immigration office and a Tops supermarket. You can also park your car here without any hassle. It is a wonderful place to disconnect and spend quality time. Highly recommended. Enjoy Phuket! Enjoy Thailand!

Blue Tree used to be a water park, and I loved coming here. It was one of my favorite places. Now, it has changed into a lifestyle shopping center with a mall, Tops, and many popular shops. Even though it’s no longer a water park, it’s still a nice place to visit, whether you want to shop, eat, or just relax.

In my opinion, Blue Tree Phuket Water Park is a fantastic place for a fun and relaxing day out. It offers a great mix of excitement and comfort, making it suitable for families and groups of friends.

First, the experience is exciting and enjoyable. The lagoon is huge and clean, and there are many activities like water slides, zip lines, and paddle boarding that keep visitors entertained for hours. Second, the service is friendly and well-organized. The staff are helpful and safety-focused, which makes the experience stress-free. Although the price is  higher than some, local waterpar the facilities are modern and well-maintained, so it feels worth the money. The food and drinks taste fresh and flavorful, though they can be a bit expensive.

Overall, I highly recommend Blue Tree Phuket Water Park because of its fun activities, good service, and clean environment. Even though the prices are not cheap, the overall experience makes it a great place to visit.

I’ve been going to Blue Tree quite regularly, and it’s become one of my favorite all-in-one spots. The colorful, vibrant buildings instantly lift your mood.

I love how lifestyle-focused it is. You can work out, join a yoga or Pilates class, then head for a massage or some self-care, all within walking distance!

There are plenty of food options too, from cafés to restaurants, so it’s easy to spend a few hours there. It’s also very practical as it provides lots of parking, pet-friendly areas, and is great for families. Kids Planet is a big plus if you want some time to yourself.

You can also run errands, grab groceries, browse shops, or pick up clothes or jewelry without going elsewhere.

Overall, it’s a well-designed, convenient place where you can do everything in one spot.
